traits.fidelity: Results byte-identical to the local git CLI (argv semantics, exit codes, stdout/stderr).
traits.zero_config: Works with no operator opt-in or extra configuration.
traits.distributed: Executes repository operations for more than one runtime node / workspace.

evidence: libs/core/vcs/local-git-backend.ts (delegates to governed safeExecResult — identical argv semantics; cwd-scope + external-operation governance stay in the typed-verb layer)
libs/core/vcs/memory-vcs-backend.ts (recording/fixture runner; hermetic tests and dry runs only — never in the default chain)

execute.description: Run shared-surface git verbs for the active runtime's working checkout.

remote_execute.description: Run the same git verbs against a checkout owned by another node (remote executor). Forge APIs (PRs, checks) are the separate vcs-host seam.
